findings.title: Non-2xx verifier responses are classified as "unavailable" and body is discarded
findings.desc: Any non-OK HTTP response from the external verifier is now treated as "verifier unavailable" without reading the response body, even if the verifier actually returned a valid `{valid:false, errors:...}` payload via a non-2xx status. This can mask genuine proof-invalid results as infrastructure failures, discard real error detail, and (via `leanRetryLoop`'s early-return on `unavailable`) prevent the normal retry-on-failure flow from running.

findings.title: `reason`/`detail` fields from the verifier route are dropped by the client
findings.desc: The route returns a `reason` (`verifier-not-configured`/`verifier-unreachable`/`verifier-error`) and optional `detail`, but `verifyLean` only reads `valid`/`errors`/`unavailable`, discarding this diagnostic information so the UI can't distinguish "not configured" from "unreachable" from "errored".

This can mask genuine proof-invalid results as infrastructure failures, discard real error detail, and (via `leanRetryLoop`'s early-return on `unavailable`) prevent the normal retry-on-failure flow from running.
2. app/components/features/lean-display/LeanCodeDisplay.tsx:132 / app/components/ui/VerificationBadge.tsx:11-19 | Low | consistency | Inconsistent "verifier offline" wording between banner and badge | The banner says "Verifier offline — proof not checked" while the badge says "Verifier offline — not checked"; minor copy inconsistency across two UI surfaces showing the same state.
3. app/lib/formalization/api.ts:126-133 | Informational | API design | `reason`/`detail` fields from the verifier route are dropped by the client | The route returns a `reason` (`verifier-not-configured`/`verifier-unreachable`/`verifier-error`) and optional `detail`, but `verifyLean` only reads `valid`/`errors`/`unavailable`, discarding this diagnostic information so the UI can't distinguish "not configured" from "unreachable" from "errored".
